footprint_basis: The four polygon footprints and the CF anchor come from outputs/railyards-v3/scene-spec.json. Source roof corners are visible in the north aerial; elevations, hidden faces and exact radii remain inferred.

medical.source_evidence: Northwestern Medicine purple two-line sign, fine vertical curtain-wall bays, stepped main/wing mass and roof garden/mechanical zones.

left_field_pavilion.source_evidence: Elongated rail-side pavilion with dark stepped/sloped roof and a lower public concourse joining bowl and crossing.

north_entertainment_hall.source_evidence: Long 4-5 story brick/glass hall with deep rooftop terrace, strong vertical bays and active park edge.

centerfield_rounded_restaurant.source_evidence: Broad curved/glazed river-facing frontage below CF board, dark rounded canopy/cornice and active upper terrace.

implementation_notes: build_adjacent_buildings adds only to MeshBatch; caller controls legacy-object visibility and flush order.
All source-facing details are intentionally low-complexity and editable: stepped masses, roof slabs, facade bays, sign panel and terrace railings.
No park, rail, bridge or skyline geometry is created by this module.
